content:
Amazon’s Black Friday Sale continues today, bringing incredible discounts on video games, LEGO sets, gaming peripherals, board games, and more. Beyond Amazon, you can also save on a Paramount+ Premium subscription for Black Friday or pick up a $100 DoorDash Gift Card for just $85. Those are just a small selection of the many deals worth checking out as we head into the weekend.

TL;DR - The Best Deals for November 20

Scroll through all of today’s deal highlights and learn more below:

Save $30 on the Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike Wireless Gaming Mouse

IGN’s top gaming mouse, the Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike Wireless Gaming Mouse, is down to $149.99 for Black Friday. This incredible mouse features an innovative Haptic Inductive Trigger System (HITS), where electromagnetic sensors cut click latency and let you adjust feedback to your liking. In fact, the entire mouse is incredibly tunable. That’s coupled with the classic tried-and-true Logitech shape and speedy sensors. The Logitech G Pro X2 Superstrike even earned a rare 10/10 rating in IGN’s review.

New for 2026: Sonos Beam Ultra Soundbar

The Sonos Beam Ultra is more than just an incremental upgrade over its Gen 2 predecessor. Like the Arc Ultra compared to the Arc, this is practically an entirely different soundbar. Although the size profile isn't much different (29 inches long vs 25 inches), the Beam Ultra now houses a total of nine total speakers instead of five. This improves the Beam's surround sound capabilities two-fold: (1) it is now technically a 7.1.2ch system instead of 5.1.2ch and (2) it has two physical upfiring speakers for true Dolby Atmos support whereas the previous Beam Gen 2 used virtual height channels for a simulated Atmos experience. Other upgrades include AI speech enhanced to isolate and amplify dialogue, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and USB-C line-in. It also has a microphone for voice control.

New for 2026: Sonos Ace Ultra Headphones

The Sonos Ace Ultra has also undergone major renovation, which isn't as surprising since the original Ace was Sonos' first foray into the world of over-ear headphones. The Ace Ultra is better sounding than ever before thanks to a combination of second generation custom engineered 40mm drivers and adaptive EQ that tunes the sound in real time based on how the headphones fit. Noise cancelation has also improved up to 2X with the presence of ten microphones instead of eight.

Get $20 Off Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition for Switch 2

A game key card of Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition for Switch 2 is down to its lowest price yet. This open-world action RPG just dropped in August for Nintendo’s console. Beyond just the base Elden Ring game, it includes the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, plus new starting classes, armors, skins, and more. Earning a 10/10 in IGN’s original review from a few years ago, Mitchell Saltzman found, “Elden Ring is a massive iteration on what FromSoftware began with the Souls series, bringing its relentlessly challenging combat to an incredible open world that gives us the freedom to choose our own path.”

Looking for Black Friday savings on more Switch 2 games? See even more deals below:

8Bitdo Ultimate 2 Bluetooth Controller Drops to Low on Amazon

The 8Bitdo Ultimate 2 Bluetooth Controller for Switch 2, Switch, and PC is down to its lowest price yet on Amazon. This controller features sensitive and precise TMR sticks, switchable Hall Effect and non-linear tactile triggers, two programmable back buttons, and the ability to save three custom profiles. The included charging dock is a nice addition, especially given the low cost.

Amazon’s Black Friday Board Game Deals

Amazon has some incredible Black Friday board game deals live, and the biggest highlight is The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship is down to just $59.99. It’s one of the best Lord of the Rings board games available, featuring cooperative gameplay between one and five players as you attempt to stop the dark forces of Sauron and Saruman. Read even more about this game in IGN’s Fate of the Fellowship review.

Check out even more gaming deals below:

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Hits New Low

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight for PS5 and Switch 2 has dropped to its lowest price yet. It’s sure to be a fun time for kids and adults alike as you follow Bruce Wayne’s origin to legendary hero. In IGN’s LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight review, Simon Cardy said it features “a strong open-world Gotham and trademark LEGO slapstick humour powers a fantastic plastic parody of Batman’s greatest hits.”

SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset Drops to $229.99

The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset is down to just $229.99 on Amazon. With incredible sound, ANC, a crystal-clear mic, and a comfortable fit, the SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro offers everything you could want in a gaming headset. A unique hot-swappable battery system also ensures you’re never without a charge, while a base station lets you tweak settings to your liking. To learn more about the 10/10-rated headset, check out IGN’s review.

That’s not the only notable SteelSeries Black Friday deal; see even more awesome discounts below:

$100 DoorDash Gift Card for $85

Do you order a lot from DoorDash or need an easy gift idea? You can grab a $100 DoorDash eGift card for only $85 at Best Buy for a limited time. DoorDash has thousands of restaurants, stores, and more to order from, so just about anyone will appreciate this gift. To make things even better, you can even buy digital video games from DoorDash along with physical games, gaming accessories, and more.

LEGO Animal Crossing Deals

Unfortunately, you can’t pay in bells, but the LEGO Animal Crossing Creative Houses: Seasons of Fun set is down to just $43.99 on an Amazon Lightning Deal. That’s $46 in savings and the lowest price I've seen. With it comes two adorable homes that can be neighbors or even stacked on top of each other as a two-story dwelling. Stitches, Fuchsia, and Fang minifigures, each with their own furniture and accessories, are included. Finally, fun modules can be decorated and changed with the season. It was recently retired, so get it while you still can.

Check out even more LEGO Animal Crossing set deals below:

Get Paramount+ Premium for $2.99/month for 2 Months

If you’ve been debating getting a Paramount+ subscription, now is a great time to buy. For Black Friday, two months of the ad-free Paramount+ Premium is just $2.99 and includes Showtime. After that trial period, the price jumps back up to $13.99 per month. The Paramount+ Essential plan is also available for that same discount and will cost $8.99 per month after the two months. No matter which plan you choose, it’s an awesome deal, especially for those looking to watch Avatar: Seven Havens, UFC, and Star Trek. This deal is open to new and former subscribers, and you can cancel anytime.

Other Black Friday streaming deals include Apple TV and Crunchyroll.

Forza Horizon 6 Xbox Wireless Controller for $49

The Limited Edition Forza Horizon 6 Xbox Wireless Controller is down to its lowest price yet. For just $49, you’ll get this awesome-looking gamepad with a transparent blue panel and vibrant, flashy colors throughout, all inspired by Forza Horizon 6. Not only is this Xbox Wireless Controller great for the console, but it’s also IGN’s top PC controller, too. Find out even more about this gamepad in IGN’s review.

That’s not the only controller discount either. Select Xbox controllers are discounted for Black Friday. See more deals below:

Samsung P9 microSD Express Card for Switch 2 Is $45

Getting or giving a Switch 2 for the holidays? An absolute must for the console is additional storage. The best deal right now, as storage prices keep rising, is on the 256GB Samsung P9 Express microSDXC. It’s IGN’s top budget microSD Express card for Switch 2 for a reason, delivering consistently reliable and speedy performance during testing. It also offers better longevity than Walmart’s cheap Onn cards.

Resident Evil Requiem Has Dropped to a New Low Price

Resident Evil Requiem for PS5, Switch 2, and Xbox Series X is only $40 on Amazon. This survival horror game that just dropped in February is full of all the gore, puzzles, and incredible boss fights you've come to expect from the iconic series. Earning a 9/10 in IGN’s review, Tristan Ogilvie said: “From my first trembling steps into its shadows all the way to the tremendous, titan-sized takedown at its climax, Resident Evil Requiem kept me completely absorbed and consistently entertained whether it was all hair-raising or all guns blazing.”

$15 Off the LEGO Dried Flower Centerpiece on More LEGO Deals

Skip the traditional Thanksgiving centerpiece this year and opt for a LEGO one instead. Right now, you can score $15 off the LEGO Dried Flower Centerpiece. The warm, autumnal colors are perfect for the season, including soft orange, deep red, and buttery yellow flowers layered with leaves and other details. After you’re finished, you can display it right on your table or even hang it on a wall.

That’s not the only Black Friday LEGO deal worth grabbing; see even more below:

44% Off The Lord of the Rings: The Motion Picture Trilogy 4K Blu-ray

A 4K Blu-ray of The Lord of the Rings Trilogy Extended Edition has dropped to the lowest price this year for Black Friday. This is arguably the best movie trilogy ever made, and a must-have in any physical media collection. All three movies are remastered in 4K, with both the theatrical cuts and extended editions available. It’s all spread across nine discs in a sturdy plastic case.

Check even more Black Friday 4K Blu-ray deals here.

Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration Drawing

Target has a few drawings up for Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration. All prices are well below the market value, if you’re lucky enough to score an invite. Honestly, this is the best way to beat the bots and scalpers right now. You get one entry per account, and you’ll be notified by email if selected. You must complete the purchase before the deadline shown in the email. You really have nothing to lose by entering.

Stellar Blade Under $30 and More PS5 Physical Game Deals

PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale brings discounts on physical PS5 games. It’s the first major price drop for the discs of Marvel’s Wolverine and Control Resonant. But Stellar Blade is another incredible deal. You can pick up a copy for the lowest price I’ve seen: $29.97. Stellar Blade “is a gorgeous action game with excellent character and monster design and exciting combat that continues to evolve in fun and interesting ways across the 30-hour adventure,” according to Mitchell Saltzman. Read even more in IGN’s Stellar Blade review. There’s even a sequel in the works, Stellar Blade: Blood Rain.

See even more PS5 game deals below:

$9 Travel Power Strip Extension Cord

Traveling during the holiday? This compact Amazon Basics Power Strip Cube 3 may be just what you need. It’s only $8.99 on Woot, and Prime members get free shipping. Featuring a five-foot cord, it’s great for getting power from hard-to-reach outlets. It also adds three AC outlets supporting up to 1250W, a USB-C(15W), and two USB-A(12W) ports for plenty of connectivity options.

Save on DualSense Controllers

Many DualSense controllers have been discounted for Black Friday. This includes special edition releases like the 007 First Light and Marathon designs. My personal favorite, the Chroma lineup, is down $20. These controllers feature a cool pearlescent finish, similar to the GTA VI DualSense, that shifts color depending on the angle. As for the controller itself, adaptive triggers, a familiar layout, and reliable performance make it an option for PS5, PC, and more.

Check out more DualSense controller deals below:
